invariants: PreCompact accepts old VaultPath parameter but never reads payload/transcript/git/vault/env or writes anything; exit0 legacy JSON continue true; official runtime discards reminder fields
SessionStart accepts old RepoRoot/DriftDir params, reads only repository drift markdown, reports unresolved count/zero/unknown without echoing supplied paths or file content; no writes; exit0
Conditional hook prose points recall/write/source disagreement to memory owner and continuity to workflow; no copied policy

Resolve-VaultRoot selects explicit argument then explicit environment then caller-supplied documented default exactly once; invalid selected root returns Ok false without fallback; empty implicit default; no input path echo
Invoke-Store reports exit outcome, never argv; underlying third-party output is still raw and must not be claimed sanitized
design: Use a payload-independent compatibility hook instead of capture/redaction. Preserve repository drift observation with unavailable state for partial reads. Single-select vault validation protects the selected destination.

Deleting hooks breaks configured call sites and legacy parameters

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
  [string]$VaultPath = ""
)

# Nonwriting compatibility hook. VaultPath remains accepted but is intentionally
# unused. No payload, transcript, environment, git or vault content is read.
# Exit 0 and legacy JSON fields are retained. Current Claude Code discards
# PreCompact systemMessage/continue; this output guarantees no context injection.
# See references/checkers-and-hooks.md for the official hook protocol.
@{
  systemMessage = 'Before compaction of an active task, use /alaa-workflow for its checkpoint and handoff.'
  continue = $true
} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
exit 0
